name: Gilman Electric Supply
old_description: An account at Gilman gains you access to Square D's Special Pricing Agreement so you can get the best switchgear for the best price.
about:
Gilman Electric Supply operates from a single location at 128-B Center Street in Auburn, Maine, positioning itself as Androscoggin County's electrical supplier of choice. The company is a member of the CED Family of Distributors, a national network that extends its reach beyond the local market. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The business distributes a broad range of electrical materials including pipe and wire, Square D switchgear, lighting fixtures, and Generac generator systems with integrated transfer switches. It offers next-day delivery on many stocked items through UPS Red Label shipping, and provides an online customer portal for ordering, quote requests, QuickBooks integration, and electronic payments. The facility maintains regular weekday hours and emphasizes detail-oriented package assembly for contractors.

Primary customers are electrical contractors and construction firms bidding on commercial, industrial, and residential projects. Gilman supports these clients with access to spec sheets, commodity pricing on pipe and wire, and value-engineered lighting packages designed to help win bids. The CED affiliation also grants access to hard-to-find items and manufacturer special pricing agreements.

Gilman states its mission is to remain detail oriented and cost effective while scaling local expertise through national capabilities. The company highlights its Square D Special Pricing Agreement and the CED network as key advantages that reduce lead times and expand product availability.
